advice: Experiment: add a dedicated output-tile path for complete 2VL-by-2VL tiles, while retaining the existing predicated path for every partial tile. In the full-tile path, use all-active predicates and form each load address from the tile base plus a reduction offset; keep the existing FP32 MOPA selectors 0–3 and increasing-k update order. This tests whether removing tail predicates and their offset handling from the common full-tile work improves execution, without assuming that n is divisible by the vector width. Check n<=0, n smaller than VL, odd n, and sizes just below and above VL and 2VL boundaries. Confirm each full-tile load and store lies within its matrix and each partial tile uses predicates and in-bounds fallback addresses for inactive vectors. Check the fixed error limit 0.002 across required shapes. This is advice only; it has not been compiled, tested, or measured.
risks: This overlaps with the prior full-tile specialization advice, so it may not count as a sufficiently distinct experiment. The historical results show large variance and no established gain. The compiler may already remove equivalent predicate work. Tail-path address or predicate mistakes could cause out-of-bounds access or incorrect results.
